name: island3_plate_a
prompt: Image 1 is an exact site plan seen from directly above. Reproduce its geometry EXACTLY in the same frame: the shoreline down the left side and every building, slab, road and the jetty must stay at the same pixel positions, sizes and proportions. Do not add, move, rotate, enlarge or remove any building. Image 2 is only a STYLE reference for colour and rendering: the same cold blue-grey night reconnaissance imagery, the same rock, surf and weathered roofs. Render the plan as a strict orthographic 90-degree top-down reconnaissance image from very high altitude, at night, of the WESTERN SHORE of a very large bare rock island with an old abandoned penitentiary on it, in the manner of Alcatraz but far bigger. Only this one side of the island is in the picture. The sea is ONLY the strip down the left side of the frame; the land fills everything else and CONTINUES PAST the top edge, the right edge and the bottom edge of the frame with no shore there: rock, scree, gullies, dead scrub, rusted fence lines and worn tracks run right up to and off those three edges. Pale surf breaks along the left shore only, on cliffs and ledges. All buildings are seen from above with their ROOFS ON: solid, opaque, weathered flat concrete and rusted sheet roofs with vents, skylights, parapets and stains. Nothing inside any building is visible; no interior walls, no cutaway, no floor plan. The two large buildings joined end to end in the middle right are the cellhouse: the left one is the main cell block with long roof lights, joined by a short covered passage to the right one, the isolation block, which has a much heavier, thicker, brighter parapet wall than any other building and a plain blank roof. The empty rectangle above the cell block is a high-walled exercise yard, open to the sky. The small building to the left of the cell block is the administration building. The big flat slab with a circle and an H is the concrete parade ground used as a helicopter pad. The round object near the shore is a lighthouse seen from above. At the top a powerhouse with a round chimney; at the upper right a round water tank on a tower; at the lower right a long workshop building cut off by the right edge of the frame; in the lower middle the roofless ruin of the staff quarters, walls only; at the top right a store cut off by the top edge. A road climbs from a small guardhouse and a concrete jetty in a cove on the shore, round the parade ground and up to the cellhouse. There is no wall around the island: the sea is the wall. The sea strip on the left is almost black with a faint swell and nothing on it. No people, no vehicles, no boats, no helicopter, no text, no labels, no numbers, no arrows, no compass, no UI, no perspective, no isometric view, no horizon.
